1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Follow one four-machine loop while one visible handoff state advances across eight clock ticks.
1.natural_language: Schedule the visible origin marbles, run the contraption, and certify the four-arrival ledger after its handoff state returns cleanly.

2.label: easy
2.summary: The original two-loop baseline now crosses a two-state handoff drum on a ten-tick timeline.
2.natural_language: Schedule every visible origin marble, run the contraption, and use the handoff trace to certify both causal loops.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Two loops interleave on an eleven-tick timeline while three handoff-memory cells preserve causal mistakes.
3.natural_language: Schedule the visible origin marbles, run the interleaved contraption, and repair any handoff state before certifying both loops.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Three interleaved loops use four marble identities and four handoff-memory cells on a thirteen-tick timeline.
4.natural_language: Schedule the visible origin marbles, watch the four-cell handoff trace through the interleaved run, and certify only a repaired closed ledger.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Three interleaved loops cross a sixteen-tick clock; five handoff-memory cells make an early wrong arrival alter the later physical run.
5.natural_language: Build the twelve-arrival ledger from the visible origins, follow the five-cell handoff trace, and repair the run before certifying it.

simplified.summary: Select a visible marble and click a machine row/tick cell; the same generated timeline, visible route/delay rules, run-revealed piece stamps, and replay contract are preserved. Clicking a placed arrival removes it for revision.

full.summary: Drag visible marble tokens onto timeline cells and drag placed arrivals to reschedule or remove them; the same generated world, run-revealed piece stamps, and causal ledger are graded.
